title: Review
subtitle: Everything that waits on you, art and audio. Only you approve, request changes or sign off a listening; agents can ask and answer, never decide.
load.slow: Still working. The first load of a big project can take a few seconds.
load.errorStale: Could not refresh: {message}. Showing the list from {time}.
inbox.label: Inbox
inbox.empty: Nothing to review. When an agent submits frames or asks for a review, it appears here.
artcount.title: Art frames by review standing
artcount.intro: Every editable frame counted once. Approved needs a human record for exactly these bytes. Baseline is shipped art from before the studio with no review record; it is not approved. Everything else awaits review.
detail.label: Selected item
detail.none: Pick an item to see what changed, what the agent asked and how to decide.
detail.unknown: That item is not in the inbox any more.
ask.title: Agent request
cmp.title: Before and after
cmp.root: This is the first revision of the frame, so there is nothing to compare with.
cmp.identical: No pixel differs from the previous revision (metadata or review only).
cmp.sizeDiffers: The two revisions have different sizes, so no pixel comparison is possible.
cmp.summary: {count} pixels changed, inside a {w}×{h} box at {x},{y}.
rev.title: Revisions and who made them
thread.title: Thread on revision {revision}
decide.title: Your decision
decide.humanOnly: Only this page can approve or request changes. No agent tool can.
decide.notHead: You are looking at an older revision. Decisions apply to the latest one, r{head}.
decide.placeholder: What should change, or why you approve
decide.conflict: A newer revision exists; reloaded. Look again before deciding.
audio.noWaveFile: No waveform without a master file.
audio.humanOnly: You sign what you heard on this exact master. An agent cannot hear, so no agent tool can sign.
audio.stale: The master changed after the last sign-off. Listen again.
audio.notePlaceholder: What you heard: seam, head and tail, mono
audio.changed: The master changed since you loaded it; reloaded. Listen again.
approval.title: Approved outside the studio sign-off form
approval.text: {by} listened to this and approved it ({pack}, {date}), before the studio existed or in chat. This is the project's record, not a sign-off made here.
approval.stale: {by} approved an earlier version of this master ({pack}, {date}). The master has changed since, so it needs a fresh listening.
detail.updated: This item changed while you were writing. Your draft is kept.
read.title: Readability read (1×)
read.intro: A human's note from the VFX tab on how this effect reads at its real size. It is information only: it changes no status.
artrec.title: Art approved on record
artrec.intro: Approved by a person in chat, then written down in assets/review/art_approvals.json against the exact bytes. If a frame changes, it is no longer covered.
artrec.current: all {n} recorded files match the approved bytes
artrec.changed: {changed} of {n} recorded files changed or are missing; {added} files added since approval. Not covered, needs a fresh look
artrec.unverified: The folder could not be checked safely, so the asset is not treated as covered.
take.intro: Three separate facts. Newest: the latest revision saved. Selected: the take a person picked. In the game: the revision whose pixels are the file the project uses now. A new take changes only the first.
take.selectLabel: Select revision {revision} as the take to use
take.picked: Revision {revision} selected. The game files did not change.
cand.title: Candidates to pick from
cand.intro: An agent made several candidates. The pixel checks already rejected the broken ones. Compare the survivors beside the reference and pick one; nothing changes until you do.
cand.referenceAlt: The reference picture for this asset
cand.noReference: No reference picture is recorded for this asset.
cand.picked: Candidate {label} selected. The game files did not change.
cand.nothingChanges: Picking selects a take. It does not change what the game uses, and it does not approve.
region.title: Change requests on a region
region.intro: Draw a box on this revision and say what to change. The note is tied to this revision's pixels, this frame and the box, and cannot be edited later. The agent's next revision must say which requests it answers.
region.canvas: This revision, {w} by {h} pixels. Drag to draw a box.
region.placeholder: What should change inside the box?
region.none: No change requests on this frame.
inbox.emptyNext: Next: ask an agent to submit frames or a cue for review, or open Characters to draw one.
undo.label: Undo
undo.done: Undone: {id} r{rev} is awaiting review again.
queue.clear: Queue clear. Nothing else is waiting for you.
progress.label: Review progress
keys.label: Keys:
seal.reduced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the seal effect stays off.
ev.title: Rubric and lineup
ev.intro: What the agent attached to its request. It is evidence for you, not an approval: only you decide, below.
ev.none.rubric: Rubric not run yet. No request for this frame carries one.
ev.none.lineup: No lineup yet. No request for this frame carries one.
ev.hint: An agent can produce it with
ev.noDefinition: This project's pack defines no rubric.
ev.mandatoryHint: A failed mandatory criterion blocks the agent's request
ev.zoom: Whole-number zoom ×{zoom} of the drawn picture ({width}×{height} px)
ev.imageMissing: The lineup picture is missing or changed since it was recorded.
